svg.title: Horse Registry physical entity relationship diagram
svg.desc: Four Horse Registry tables: horse, horse ownership, horse document, horse medical record. External enterprise core party referenced by ownership and medical record. Two horse self references for sire and dam. Seven foreign keys in total.
svg.text: Shared owner/veterinarian identity · not duplicated here
PEDIGREE · sire_id and dam_id both reference horse.id (self-FKs)
Each owner share > 0 and ≤ 100; effective date range
Dashed green links = references to enterprise_core.party · Deletion restricted by declared foreign keys
